content.executiveSummary: Complete data flow trace for dynamic activity creation in DevBob Kubernetes environment, from user intent through distributed execution, persistence, and metrics learning. Implements sophisticated A/B testing with Thompson Sampling, with observability at every layer via kubectl logs.

architecture.learningMechanism: Thompson Sampling with Beta distribution for template evolution
architecture.observability: Complete traceability via kubectl logs at all boundaries

dataFlow.summary: User/LLM invokes ActivityTool.execute → Template Selection (Thompson Sampling via RPC API) → Variable Validation (Levenshtein fuzzy match) → Activity Creation (ulid, git state capture) → Dual-Write (local storage + MCP delegation) → MCP forward (CLI MCP Server → RPC API) → Persistence (SurrealDB activity_executions + Redis cache) → Task Execution Loop (LLM interactions) → Completion (metrics calculation) → Learning Loop (RPC API update_metrics_after_execution → SurrealDB template_metrics with Thompson Sampling params update) → Return result to user

phases.algorithm: Beta(alpha, beta) sampling for variant selection
transformations: Load metrics: α = successes + 1, β = failures + 1
Select variant: stable if sample >= 0.5, else candidate
Fuzzy match with Levenshtein distance for typo suggestions
Clean impulses for storage (remove content from unloaded)
For each task: SessionPrompt.prompt → LLM interaction → Task result
Thompson Sampling parameter update (α += 1 if success, β += 1 if failure)

criticalIssues.issue: Metrics update race condition (read-modify-write without transaction isolation)
criticalIssues.impact: Concurrent executions could clobber metrics (accuracy issue under load)
criticalIssues.mitigation: Use atomic increment operations or advisory locks (Redis SETNX)
criticalIssues.validationCommand: Concurrent execution test: run 10 activities in parallel, verify metrics count = 10

criticalIssues.impact: KeyError crashes metrics update if malformed data
criticalIssues.mitigation: Use Pydantic model for validation (ExecutionRequest schema)
criticalIssues.validationCommand: Send malformed execution_data, verify graceful error handling (not KeyError crash)

keyInsights.businessPurpose: Enable continuous improvement of activity templates through empirical evidence and A/B testing, while maintaining complete traceability in distributed DevBob Kubernetes environments.

criticalDecisions.rationale: Bayesian approach handles uncertainty naturally; epsilon-greedy has fixed exploration rate (suboptimal)
criticalDecisions.impact: Superior long-term performance in A/B testing (proven in academic literature)

criticalDecisions.rationale: Architectural boundary enforcement, clean separation of concerns
criticalDecisions.impact: Additional latency (~10-50ms) but enables clean architecture and easier evolution

criticalDecisions.rationale: User experience prioritized over eventual consistency
criticalDecisions.impact: Users never lose work due to network issues; backend provides distributed access

criticalDecisions.rationale: O(1) time complexity enables real-time learning without batch processing
criticalDecisions.impact: Slight floating-point precision loss (negligible) vs massive performance gain
System continues with degraded functionality; failures logged for debugging

strengths: Complete traceability via kubectl logs (DevBob K8s environment)
Bayesian A/B testing (Thompson Sampling) for continuous improvement
Graceful degradation (non-critical failures don't fail workflow)

improvements.improvement: Add minimal logging to event bus
Implement advisory locks for metrics updates
